permit.applies: The employer applies to the Department of Labour and Workforce Development for a work permit for each non-Belonger or non-Virgin Islander it means to employ, at least 10 days before work begins (the Department's festival bulletin).
permit.first: An application filed at least 10 days before the work starts.

sources.title: Government of the Virgin Islands, Department of Labour Urges Employers to Comply With Labour Code (24 July 2025)
sources.said: The Department of Labour and Workforce Department is urging employers to submit work permit applications at least 10 days prior to the commencement of work during the upcoming VI Emancipation Festival. Failure to do so will render persons in direct violation of Section 171 of the 2010 Labour Code. Accordingly, all employers operating on the Festival Grounds are urged to apply for and obtain a work permit for non-Belongers or non-Virgin Islander that they are seeking to employ.
